"''Then let me give you peace, Master Yaddle.|Dooku and Yaddle|audio=DookuKillsYaddle.flac|{{TOTJ|The Sith Lord}}}} '''Dooku''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Serennian]] who served as a [[Jedi Master]] during the [[Republic Era|waning years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and later [[Count]] of [[House Serenno]]. He became dissatisfied with the [[Jedi Order]] and fell to the [[dark side of the Force]], becoming the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] '''Darth Tyranus'''. After [[Lost Twenty|leaving]] the Jedi Order, he served as [[House Serenno|Count]] of [[Serenno]] and [[Head of State]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He was a backup for Darth Sidious, the Dark Lord of the Sith, whose plan to conquer [[the galaxy]] relied on Dooku leading a pan-[[Galaxy|galactic]] [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist movement]] against the Republic. As such, Dooku immersed himself in the dark side of [[the Force]] and worked tirelessly to advance his and his [[Sith Master|master's]] [[Grand Plan]] while being unaware that he was merely a pawn of his master. [[Reproduction|Born]] in [[102 BBY]] during the [[High Republic Era]], Dooku was taken by the Jedi Order after being abandoned by his [[House Serenno|family]] and [[Jedi training|learned]] the Jedi arts as the [[Padawan]] of [[Yoda]], the legendary [[Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order; he went on to take [[Rael Averross]] and the maverick [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] as his two Padawan learners at different points, before eventually ascending to the [[Jedi Council]]. He went on to become a respected and legendary Jedi Master in his own right. A [[Politics|political]] idealist, the corruption in the [[Galactic Senate]]—as well as the [[Jedi Code|traditions of the Jedi]]—disillusioned him. In [[42 BBY]] Dooku left the Order and returned to his [[homeworld]], where he reclaimed his title of Count and heritage as a [[noble]]man after [[Incident on Serenno|overthrowing]] his corrupt brother, [[Ramil]]. His former peers believed his decision was misguided but still held him in high esteem. However the Count of Serenno began to secretly conspire with Darth Sidious. After the [[death]] of Qui-Gon Jinn at the [[Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY]], and following the [[Duel in the Works|duel]] in [[the Works]] which saw the death of Jedi Master [[Yaddle]], Dooku embraced the dark side and adopted the name of Darth Tyranus upon fully becoming the apprentice of Darth Sidious. Throughout the first [[Standard decade|decade]] of Sheev Palpatine's [[Supreme Chancellor|chancellery]], Dooku used his resources and charisma to recruit entire [[star system]]s to the Separatist cause. At the same [[time]], he oversaw the development of two vast [[Army|armies]] that would be pitted against each other in the conflict to come: the [[Separatist Droid Army]], which consisted of [[battle droid]]s manufactured on worlds such as [[Geonosis]]; and the [[Grand Army of the Republic]], composed of [[clone trooper]]s [[Cloning|bred]] on [[Kamino]] and [[Clone template|modeled]] on the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]. After [[Standard year|years]] of maneuvering the galaxy into a state of war, the Clone Wars began when the newly formed [[Republic Military]] [[First Battle of Geonosis|invaded Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY]]. As leader of the Separatists, Dooku delegated [[Confederacy military|military]] authority to a cadre of subordinates personally trained by himself, including [[General]] [[Grievous]] and [[Asajj Ventress]]. While Grievous was trained only in the art of [[lightsaber combat]], Ventress was [[Midi-chlorian|strong]] with [[the Force]], affording her the opportunity to learn the ways of the dark side from Dooku. The Sith, however, remained faithful to [[Darth Bane]]'s [[Rule of Two]]; and as such, Dooku was compelled to betray his disciple after Sidious became suspicious of his own apprentice's intentions. Though he sought to replace Ventress with [[Savage Opress]] and later [[Quinlan Vos]], Dooku ultimately remained beholden to his master's will, which would eventually be his undoing. By the third year of the war, Dooku and Grievous succeeded in abducting Chancellor Palpatine (per Sidious' plan) from the Republic [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of Coruscant]], he was [[Lightsaber duel|confronted]] and defeated by the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], who summarily [[Death penalty|executed]] the Count via [[Death|beheading]] at the Chancellor's behest. In the [[Standard day|days]] following Dooku's death, Palpatine revealed to the Jedi that he was, in fact, Darth Sidious, who betrayed his apprentice in order to replace him with the younger and more promising Skywalker. With the subsequent [[Great Jedi Purge|fall of the Jedi Order]], Sidious [[New Order|consolidated his power]] upon [[Proclamation of the New Order|declaring]] himself [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which Tyranus had an instrumental role in establishing. As for Skywalker, he succeeded the late Darth Tyranus as Sidious' third and last apprentice, resulting in his transformation into Darth Vader and proving his slain victim's words of sensing fear, hate, and anger.
